# Crop Fields for Lower Saxony / Bremen / Hamburg, Germany

Germany, Lower Saxony/Bremen/Hamburg field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from ML/SLA Niedersachsen. License: DL-DE-BY-2.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nds/latest/de_nds.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nds/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25832; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: flik, collection, geometry, hcat:name_en, id, hcat:name, subfield_id, crop:code, hcat:code, metrics:area, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nds/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nds/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_nds/collection.json
